scope: Poem Without Borders repository: I Am Free to Dream language collection
mode: Source-based Human Natural / Poetic Natural editorial comparison of existing song adaptations; musical structures preserved

source.hash_algorithm: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 file bytes

intent: Intimate permission to dream, lose the road, gather and shape a world, invite companionship and weave dreams together; quiet joy, without adding promises or explanatory morals.
meaning_authority: Author-supplied original.md; existing meaning.md and author directions. The rain reading is an existing contextual interpretation; blooming smiles are expressly permitted by the meaning guide.
not_in_scope: Separate unpublished Kabita Prusta English anthology outside the website collection
limits: Review covers the 29 current base language-page lyrics, not every historical Suno submission.
No audio was heard or acoustically evaluated. Variant-specific sung words, timings and pronunciation remain unverified.
No fluent speaker or author has approved these revisions. All existing native-review statuses remain.
All 72 adaptation briefs remain pending. Their English scaffolds must not be submitted as translated lyrics.
Dialect and specialist questions in individual records remain unresolved; no speculative word replacements were made.
